subject: Staged license transfer & commitment uplift — renewal sequencing and SLA onboarding
messages:
From: Rachel Stone <procurement@novamed.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <legal@novamed.com>, aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal and staged license transfer — Novamed Q4 uplift

Hi Kimberly,

Quick background: Novamed is ready to renew and increase committed spend for Q4 to cover an expanded production rollout. They want to accept via AWS Private Offer but need two things coordinated before sign: (1) a staged license transfer so a subset of consumption can move immediately into the committed bucket while the rest follows after tax signoff, and (2) SLA onboarding details for our Dedicated capacity (latency SLA escalation path + credits).

Can your team confirm the acceptance sequencing we usually follow for private offers and whether we can split the acceptance window by tax jurisdiction (US / EU) so Novamed can route invoices appropriately? Attached is the initial PO and their procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Rachel Stone
Procurement Manager, Novamed Health
Attachments: Novamed_PO_Q4_2028.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Rachel Stone <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, Samir Patel <legal@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and staged license transfer — Novamed Q4 uplift

Thanks Rachel — looping in Marcus (billing), Rishi (marketplace/PO ops), Jordan (legal handoff) to confirm a recommended sequence. High-level proposal from our side:

- Step A (Day 0-3): Accept private offer for the committed uplift covering US region only. This allows immediate application of committed capacity to US tenancy.
- Step B (Day 4-14): Tax evidence collection for EU invoicing; once validated we finalize the second acceptance tranche and split invoices.
- Step C (Day 15-30): SLA onboarding for Dedicated capacity — we run a 72-hour smoke to validate latency baselines, then sign off formal SLA and operational runbook.

Can Marcus/Rishi confirm any limitations on staggered acceptance for AWS Private Offers (we've done regional splits before but want to ensure billing buckets map cleanly)? Jordan — can Legal prepare a short amendment accommodating the two-tranche acceptance and an SLA addendum? I'm attaching an evidence checklist we typically use.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Renewals, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Acceptance_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 13:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and staged license transfer — Novamed Q4 uplift

Kimberly / team — wrote up constraints from billing side:

- AWS Private Offers allow partial acceptance semantics but we need to create two separate acceptance events that map to two distinct PO line-items. We can accept US tranche first.
- Taxes: if Novamed needs EU VAT handling on a separate invoice, we must ensure the second tranche is tied to a different invoice run (we can schedule). That will cause two billing documents in our system.
- Credits/SLA: credits are applied at the commitment level; since commitment will be a single contract we will need an SLA addendum that references the overall commitment and defines credit allocation per tranche.

Operational ask for Rishi: when we create the second acceptance event, can your team ensure usage attribution stays continuous so customers don't see a gap in their consumed tokens? We've handled this before by tagging the tenancy and preserving usage attribution in the billing export.

Marcus
Director, Revenue Operations
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, Rachel Stone <procurement@novamed.com>, Samir Patel <legal@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Nov 2028 09:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and staged license transfer — Novamed Q4 uplift

On Thu, Nov 1, 2028 at 10:04 AM kimberly_park@redwood.com wrote:
> Can Marcus/Rishi confirm any limitations on staggered acceptance for AWS Private Offers...

Quick confirmation from ops:

- We can implement the two acceptance events for AWS Private Offer. Implementation notes: create AO-accept-US (effective immediately) and AO-accept-EU (pending tax evidence). Both will point to the same underlying commitment id but will be separate acceptance records in AWS and in our billing pipeline.
- Usage continuity: we will maintain the customer's tenancy id and apply a mapping layer so consumption is attributed to active tranche until the EU tranche becomes live. There will be an internal handover window (~1 hour) where attribution keys are flipped — we'll schedule it during a low-traffic window.
- SLA onboarding: ops will run the 72-hour smoke for Dedicated nodes. We need Novamed to provide the list of test routes and expected p95 numbers.

Action items:
1) Jordan to produce draft amendment (legal).
2) Marcus to confirm invoice cadence for the two-tranche approach.
3) Kimberly to confirm timelines with Novamed procurement and provide DocuSign link once amendment is ready.

Rishi Malhotra
Marketplace Integrations Lead, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Rachel Stone <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, Samir Patel <legal@novamed.com>, aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 07 Nov 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and staged license transfer — Novamed Q4 uplift

Hi Rachel — thanks for the fast follow. Confirming the proposed sequence below and next steps we will kick off on our side: 

Planned sequence (confirmed):
- Day 0 (Approval & DocuSign): Novamed signs the amendment for the US tranche via DocuSign. We execute AO-accept-US same day. (Attachment: Draft_Commitment_Amendment.docx)
- Day 1-7 (Tax evidence): Novamed provides EU tax evidence (VAT forms); Samir will review and mark for acceptance.
- Day 8-12 (Second acceptance): Once evidence is validated we execute AO-accept-EU and issue EU invoice.
- Day 12-16 (SLA onboarding): Ops will run the 72-hour smoke for Dedicated nodes; if baselines meet targets we finalize SLA and publish runbook.

Practical notes:
- Marcus: please confirm the invoice number scheme we will use for two separate invoice docs so Novamed finance can map them.
- Samir: please add one paragraph to the amendment that states the two-tranche acceptance and that credits are applied at the contract level with allocation guidance.
- Rachel: please confirm the preferred window for the 1-hour usage attribution flip (we recommend 1:00–2:00 AM PT to minimize user impact).

Attaching the draft amendment and the evidence checklist for your teams. If everything looks good we'll send the DocuSign package by EOD tomorrow so Novamed procurement can sign and we can accept the US tranche on Friday.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Renewals, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Draft_Commitment_Amendment.docx, Acceptance_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx
